subject.title: fix(agents): skip sender-scoped tool policy when sender identity is absent

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a shared verified requester-policy projection that covers both spawned children and requester-agent fallback, rather than merge this spawn-only propagation path?
rationale: The remaining choice defines the authorization boundary for identity-less internal descendants; the narrower branch and the broader alternative make materially different ownership and coverage tradeoffs.

options.title: Adopt the shared lineage model
options.body: Use or narrow the broader approach so every verified internal descendant consumes the same requester-policy projection before child restrictions are applied.

options.title: Keep the spawn-only fix
options.body: Merge only after explicitly accepting that fallback continuation remains separately tracked and cannot regain the parent policy in this PR.

options.title: Pause this branch for the alternative
options.body: Review the broader proof-positive candidate first and close or supersede this PR only if that implementation becomes the approved landing path.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared lineage model
recommendation.body: Use or narrow the broader approach so every verified internal descendant consumes the same requester-policy projection before child restrictions are applied.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent implementation is the only concrete evidence here for the broader internal-lineage boundary.
